title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on energy-intensive industries
part_text: 6.Underlines the need to phase out natural gas as soon as possible; stresses *the need to strengthen funding mechanisms to support the decarbonisation of EIIs thus supporting the adoption of renewable technologies and energy-efficient production methods; recalls that carbon management strategies should be used only for residual emissions that cannot be reduced otherwise, and only as a last resort; calls for State aid procedures that allow for agile and effective support of EIIs that invest in decarbonisation technologies and that ensure high social standards;
